summary.text: On Innistrad, where the angel Avacyn has been trapped in the Helvault since Griselbrand tricked her into banishing him and pulled her in after him, Liliana Vess coerces Thalia into letting her shatter the silver shard, freeing Avacyn, Griselbrand and the other demons.

Avacyn returns to lead a renewed crusade of angels and restores holy magic, but she is driven mad when Nahiri, freed from the Helvault and bent on vengeance against Sorin, builds cryptoliths that summon Emrakul.

Corrupted, Avacyn abandons humanity and becomes the advocate of its genocide, and the Battle of Thraben follows as Sigarda and Thalia fight the corrupted angels, while Liliana uses the Chain Veil to destroy Griselbrand for good.
